input.query: SELECT signup_month, SUM(n_signups) n_signups, SUM(n_activated) n_activated, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) activation_rate, SUM(n_email_verified)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) email_rate, SUM(n_kyc_started)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) kyc_start_rate, SUM(n_doc_submitted)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) doc_rate, SUM(n_kyc_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) kyc_approval_rate, SUM(n_first_topup)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) topup_rate FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' GROUP BY signup_month ORDER BY signup_month

SELECT signup_month, device, n_signups, n_activated, n_activated::DOUBLE/n_signups activation_rate, n_kyc_started::DOUBLE/n_signups kyc_start_rate, n_doc_submitted::DOUBLE/n_signups doc_rate, n_kyc_approved::DOUBLE/n_signups kyc_approval_rate, n_first_topup::DOUBLE/n_signups topup_rate FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN ('2026-03-01','2026-04-01') ORDER BY signup_month, device
SELECT platform, version, release_date FROM stg_app_releases WHERE release_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY release_date
